alias.en: Sudden swelling and irritation of the gallbladder, usually from a gallstone
alias.zh: 胆囊突然肿胀发炎，通常由胆结石引起
alias.ms: Pundi hempedu tiba-tiba membengkak dan teriritasi, biasanya kerana batu hempedu

lead.en: A gallstone often blocks the exit of the gallbladder, which then swells and becomes inflamed. It causes pain in the upper right belly and needs prompt medical care.
lead.zh: 胆结石常堵住胆囊的出口，胆囊就会肿胀发炎，引起右上腹疼痛，需要尽快就医。
lead.ms: Batu hempedu sering menyekat saluran keluar pundi hempedu, lalu ia bengkak dan meradang. Ia menyebabkan sakit di perut kanan atas dan perlu rawatan perubatan segera.

v.en: Family doctor today; hospital or surgeon
v.zh: 当天看家庭医生；去医院或看外科医生
v.ms: Doktor keluarga hari ini; hospital atau pakar bedah
Orang dewasa yang ada batu hempedu

v.en: Needs a doctor; it can become serious if left alone
v.zh: 需要看医生；不处理可能变严重
v.ms: Perlu jumpa doktor; boleh menjadi serius jika dibiarkan

li.en: A gallstone blocking the gallbladder outlet
li.ms: Batu hempedu menyekat saluran keluar pundi hempedu

li.en: Being very ill, for example in hospital
li.zh: 病得很重，例如住院期间
li.ms: Sakit teruk, contohnya semasa di hospital

h.zh: 出现这些情况请先看医生

li.en: Severe pain in the upper right belly that lasts for hours: go to hospital
li.zh: 右上腹剧痛持续数小时：去医院
li.ms: Sakit teruk di perut kanan atas berjam-jam: ke hospital

li.en: Confusion, fainting or a very fast heartbeat: call 999
li.zh: 意识混乱、昏倒或心跳很快：拨打999
li.ms: Keliru, pitam atau degupan jantung sangat laju: hubungi 999

p.en: If any apply, please see a doctor before a session.
p.zh: 如果有以上情况，请先看医生，再来做调理。
p.ms: Jika mana-mana berkenaan, sila jumpa doktor sebelum sesi.

p.en: This page is general information. Please keep taking your normal medicine and keep seeing your doctor.
p.zh: 本页只是一般性的健康资讯。请继续按时服用平常的药物，并继续看医生。
p.ms: Halaman ini ialah maklumat am. Sila terus mengambil ubat biasa anda dan terus berjumpa doktor.

li.en: See a doctor the same day
li.ms: Jumpa doktor pada hari yang sama

li.en: Avoid heavy or fatty meals while you are in pain
li.zh: 疼痛时不要吃油腻或太饱的食物
li.ms: Elakkan makanan berat atau berlemak ketika sakit

li.en: Take small sips of fluids and avoid alcohol
li.ms: Minum air sedikit demi sedikit dan elakkan alkohol

li.en: Follow your doctor's plan and go to follow-up visits
li.zh: 按医生的安排去做，并按时复诊
li.ms: Ikut pelan doktor anda dan hadir ke temu janji susulan

tell.en: Diabetes or less feeling in the skin
tell.zh: 糖尿病或皮肤感觉减退

refs: General information based on public health sources such as Mayo Clinic, NHS, Cleveland Clinic and NCBI StatPearls.
